items.title: Find the Animals
items.task: Find five giant 3D restaurant signs. Photograph the weirdest.

items.title: The Running Man
items.task: Find the running man. Guess what he sells.
items.reveal: Glico. A sweets and food company. The pose is an advert that became a meeting point.
items.notes: Confirm Glico sign product/history wording. Keep it brief.

items.title: Why Is There a River Here?
items.task: Look at the canal. Natural river, or dug?
items.reveal: A human-made canal. Named after people who paid to dig. Confirm Doton / Yasui Doton before live.
items.notes: Confirm Doton / Yasui Doton canal history before live.

items.title: Osaka's Broadway
items.hook: Before the neon food, this street was famous for plays.
items.reveal: Dotonbori was a theatre quarter. Food signs came later.
items.notes: Confirm Dotonbori as a theatre quarter before the food signs.

items.title: Kuidaore
items.task: Try three Osaka foods: takoyaki, okonomiyaki, kushikatsu.
items.rewardIdea: Kids choose a fourth snack. Not money in the app.
items.notes: Progressive. Engine stores one answer until a collector exists.
